scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 9-UNIT NAZARIYA (44-bet, PDF 43). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '9', sarlavha: 'The Passive - Too - Enough'. Och pushti ramka.

'The Passive: to be + past participle' - 'Form': • We form the passive with the verb to be and the past participle of the main verb. JADVAL Active / Passive: present simple: He feeds the dog twice a day. / The dog is fed twice a day. past simple: He fed the dog yesterday. / The dog was fed yesterday. present perfect simple: He has fed the dog. / The dog has been fed. future simple: He will feed the dog. / The dog will be fed. modal: He should feed the dog. / The dog should be fed. • We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject. 'Is this car made in Japan?' • We form negations with the word not. 'His bicycle was not/wasn't stolen last night.'
'Turning from Active into Passive': • To turn a sentence from the active into the passive: a) The object of the active sentence becomes the subject in the passive sentence. b) The active verb changes into a passive form. c) The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent. JADVAL: ACTIVE - subject: Susan / verb: made / object: a cake. PASSIVE - subject: A cake / verb: was made / agent: by Susan. • Only the verbs that take an object can be turned into the passive. 'Tom watered the plants. → The plants were watered by Tom. But: It is raining today. (This sentence cannot be turned into the passive because the verb does not take an object.)' • When the subject of the active sentence is one of the following words: people, one, someone/somebody, they, he, etc., the agent is often omitted in the passive sentence. 'Someone will feed the dog. → The dog will be fed.' • Object pronouns (me, you, him, etc) become subject pronouns (I, you, he, etc) in the passive. 'She gave me some money. → I was given some money.' • When the verb of the active sentence is followed by a preposition, the preposition is kept in the passive sentence as well. 'Someone broke into our house last night. → Our house was broken into last night.'
'Use': • We use the passive when we want to show that the action of the verb is more important than the agent (i.e. the person or thing doing or causing the action). The agent is introduced with the preposition by and is mentioned only when it is important or needs to be stated. 'Oliver Twist was written by Charles Dickens.' • The agent is not mentioned when: a it is unknown. 'His car was stolen last night. (We don't know who stole his car.)' b it is unimportant. 'Breakfast will be served at 7.30. (the agent is unimportant.)' c it is obvious from the context. 'He has been arrested. (it is obvious who arrested him - the police)'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '44'.

exercises.instructionEn: We form the passive with the verb to be and the past participle of the main verb. Present simple: He feeds the dog twice a day. → The dog is fed twice a day. Past simple: He fed the dog yesterday. → The dog was fed yesterday. Present perfect simple: He has fed the dog. → The dog has been fed. Future simple: He will feed the dog. → The dog will be fed. Modal: He should feed the dog. → The dog should be fed. Questions: to be before the subject: Is this car made in Japan? Negations: with not: His bicycle wasn't stolen last night.
exercises.instructionUz: Majhul nisbat 'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli bilan yasaladi. Present simple: U itni kuniga ikki marta boqadi. → It kuniga ikki marta boqiladi. Past simple: U kecha itni boqdi. → It kecha boqildi. Present perfect: U itni boqdi. → It boqilgan. Future simple: U itni boqadi. → It boqiladi. Modal: U itni boqishi kerak. → It boqilishi kerak. Savol: to be egadan oldin: Bu mashina Yaponiyada ishlab chiqarilganmi? Inkor: not bilan: Uning velosipedi kecha o'g'irlanmagan.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL NISBAT = TO BE + V3.

  Zamon 'TO BE' ORQALI ko'rsatiladi,
  V3 o'zgarmaydi:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:  is / are + V3
    The dog IS FED twice a day.
  PAST SIMPLE:     was / were + V3
    The dog WAS FED yesterday.
  PRESENT PERFECT: has / have BEEN
    + V3
    The dog HAS BEEN FED.
  FUTURE:          will BE + V3
    The dog WILL BE FED.
  MODAL:           should BE + V3
    The dog SHOULD BE FED.

  SAVOL: IS this car made in Japan?
  INKOR: His bicycle WASN'T stolen.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  Majhul = '-il' / '-in' qo'shimchasi:
  boqadi → boqILadi; yozdi →
  yozILdi; o'g'irladi → o'g'irLANdi.

exercises.instructionEn: To turn a sentence from the active into the passive: a) The object of the active sentence becomes the subject in the passive sentence. b) The active verb changes into a passive form. c) The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent. ACTIVE: Susan (subject) made (verb) a cake (object). PASSIVE: A cake (subject) was made (verb) by Susan (agent). Only the verbs that take an object can be turned into the passive: Tom watered the plants. → The plants were watered by Tom. But: It is raining today. (cannot be turned into the passive). When the subject of the active sentence is people, one, someone/somebody, they, he, etc., the agent is often omitted: Someone will feed the dog. → The dog will be fed. Object pronouns (me, you, him) become subject pronouns (I, you, he): She gave me some money. → I was given some money. When the verb is followed by a preposition, the preposition is kept: Someone broke into our house last night. → Our house was broken into last night.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapni faoldan majhulga o'tkazish: a) Faol gapning TO'LDIRUVChISI majhul gapning EGASI bo'ladi. b) Faol fe'l majhul shaklga o'tadi. c) Faol gapning EGASI BAJARUVChI (agent) bo'ladi. FAOL: Syuzan (ega) tayyorladi (fe'l) tort (to'ldiruvchi). MAJHUL: Tort (ega) tayyorlandi (fe'l) Syuzan tomonidan (bajaruvchi). Faqat TO'LDIRUVChI OLADIGAN fe'llar majhulga o'tadi: Tom gullarni sug'ordi. → Gullar Tom tomonidan sug'orildi. Lekin: Bugun yomg'ir yog'yapti. (to'ldiruvchi yo'q - majhulga o'tmaydi). Faol gapning egasi people, one, someone, they, he bo'lsa, bajaruvchi ko'pincha TUShIB QOLADI: Kimdir itni boqadi. → It boqiladi. Tushum olmoshlari (me, you, him) ega olmoshlariga (I, you, he) aylanadi: U menga pul berdi. → Menga pul berildi. Fe'ldan keyin predlog bo'lsa, u SAQLANADI: Kimdir kecha uyimizga bostirib kirdi. → Uyimizga kecha bostirib kirildi.
exercises.explanationUz:
FAOL → MAJHUL - 3 QADAM.

  FAOL:   Susan  made      a cake.
          (ega)  (fe'l)    (to'ld.)
             ↘            ↙
  MAJHUL: A cake was made by Susan.
          (ega)  (majhul)  (bajaruvchi)

  a) To'ldiruvchi → ega
  b) Fe'l → to be + V3
  c) Ega → by + bajaruvchi


QOIDALAR:

  1) FAQAT TO'LDIRUVChILI fe'llar:
     Tom watered THE PLANTS. →
     The plants were watered.
     ⚠ 'It is raining' → majhul
     YO'Q (to'ldiruvchi yo'q).

  2) BAJARUVChI TUShADI (someone,
     people, they):
     Someone will feed the dog. →
     The dog will be fed. ('by
     someone' yozilmaydi)

  3) TUShUM OLMOSh → EGA OLMOSh:
     She gave ME money. → I was
     given money.

  4) PREDLOG SAQLANADI:
     Someone broke INTO our house.
     → Our house was broken INTO.

exercises.instructionUz: Majhul nisbat HARAKAT bajaruvchidan MUHIMROQ bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Bajaruvchi 'by' predlogi bilan kiritiladi va faqat muhim bo'lganda aytiladi: 'Oliver Tvist' Charlz Dikkens tomonidan yozilgan. Bajaruvchi aytilmaydi: a) noma'lum bo'lsa: Uning mashinasi kecha o'g'irlandi. (Kim o'g'irlaganini bilmaymiz.) b) muhim bo'lmasa: Nonushta 7:30 da beriladi. c) matndan ayon bo'lsa: U hibsga olindi. (kim hibsga olgani ayon - politsiya)
exercises.explanationUz:
MAJHUL QAChON IShLATILADI?

  HARAKAT muhim, BAJARUVChI emas.

  BAJARUVChI (by ...) FAQAT MUHIM
  BO'LSA aytiladi:
    Oliver Twist was written BY
    CHARLES DICKENS. (kim yozgani
    muhim)

  BAJARUVChI AYTILMAYDI:
  a) NOMA'LUM:
     His car WAS STOLEN last night.
     (kim o'g'irlagani noma'lum)
  b) MUHIM EMAS:
     Breakfast WILL BE SERVED at
     7.30. (kim berishi muhim emas)
  c) AYON:
     He HAS BEEN ARRESTED. (albatta
     politsiya)


⚠ 'BY' - BAJARUVChI OLDIDAN:

  'written by Dickens' (from ✗, of
  ✗).


⚠ 'TO ARREST':

  = hibsga olmoq.

patterns.formula: NIMA + is / was / will be / has been + V3 (+ by KIM)
patterns.exampleEn: The dog is fed twice a day. Oliver Twist was written by Charles Dickens.
patterns.exampleUz: It kuniga ikki marta boqiladi. 'Oliver Tvist' Charlz Dikkens tomonidan yozilgan.

patterns.formula: FAOL: KIM + FE'L + NIMA → MAJHUL: NIMA + to be + V3 + by + KIM
patterns.exampleEn: Susan made a cake. → A cake was made by Susan.
patterns.exampleUz: Syuzan tort tayyorladi. → Tort Syuzan tomonidan tayyorlandi.

patterns.formula: Is / Was + NIMA + V3 ...? — NIMA + wasn't + V3
patterns.exampleEn: Is this car made in Japan? His bicycle wasn't stolen last night.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu mashina Yaponiyada ishlab chiqarilganmi? Uning velosipedi o'g'irlanmagan.

patterns.formula: Someone + FE'L + NIMA → NIMA + to be + V3 (bajaruvchi tushadi)
patterns.exampleEn: Someone will feed the dog. → The dog will be fed.
